banner: DEMONSTRATION ONLY; N=7 of 649 good-tier mare DTMs sampled (P4.3 Powell 2023 thermal/rock evidence at G1 scale; Phase-3 G1 banner)

data.citation: Powell et al. 2023 (LRO Diviner GHRM, PDS Geosciences Node urn:nasa:pds:lro_diviner_derived1:data_derived_ghrm); see also Williams et al. 2017 Icarus 283, 300-325 (cumulative nighttime T algorithm).

sampling.sentinel_handling: Powell 2023 GHRM GeoTIFFs encode the missing-data sentinel as float32 0.0 (NOT NaN as the PDS4 XML claims; verified empirically at equator: 96% of pixels are 0.0 with the remaining 4% physically realistic). TBOL 0 K is non-physical; RA 0.0 fraction matches the TBOL density pattern so it is treated as the same sentinel, not a valid bare-mare value. Pixels with value <= 0.0 (including NaN/inf) are excluded from all aggregates.

INGENIIPIT.tube_interpretation: WARMER (+2.65 K) than mare-median; RA 0.98% vs 0.50% local mare ≈2× → rocky ejecta, NOT void cooling. Counter-evidence for tube hypothesis at this site; inconclusive / counter-evidence for the thermal-anomaly leg.

interpretation: INCONCLUSIVE at N=7 due to Powell GHRM equatorial/sub-arctic coverage gap (4/7 DTMs all-sentinel, 1/7 partial, 2/7 fully usable). The 2/7 fully usable sites show one marginal 2σ anomaly at INGENIIPIT only. See g1_honesty.

g1_honesty.anomaly_count_interpretation: All 24 anomalies are from N=1 distinct catalogued pit (INGENIIPIT), 13 positions × 3 scale tiers (2/4/5 m). The 24/44 = 54.5% headline is over a single pit — NOT 24 independent sites.
g1_honesty.coverage: 4/7 DTMs in Powell GHRM equatorial/sub-arctic gap band (zero usable thermal: TRANQPIT1, MARIUSPIT01, IRIDIUMPIT1, PRCLRMPIT01); 1/7 partial (SWFECUNPIT1: T ok, RA all sentinel); 2/7 fully usable (INGENIIPIT, FECNDITATS2). Only 2/7 catalogued pits have usable thermal data — a G1 honest coverage flag.
g1_honesty.spatial_scale: Powell 2023 GHRM is 128 ppd (236.9 m/px at equator; 150 m at INGENIIPIT −36°; 81 m at IRIDIUMPIT1 +46°). 1-km inner box averages over mostly mare pixels. Tube-scale (≤100 m) thermal anomalies are sub-pixel at all 7 DTMs — G1 thermal leg is site-scale only; tube-scale unresolved at Powell 2023 resolution.
g1_honesty.stacking: Multi-evidence stacking at G1 is morphometry-only (Z2 active at 7/7 DTMs); thermal at 2/7 fully usable; photometric-stereo (P4.2) deferred to post-G1. G1 cannot claim multi-evidence stacking.
